title: Close the one-row minimax rate with an expected-stopping information bound
statement: For every admitted batch algorithm sup(P,Q) E N_Q>=c0 d/eta. For even d take uniform P and paired-sign Q with probabilities (1+-delta sigma)/d, delta=4eta. For a uniform actual original row J, mismatch E is at least4eta conditioned on its label being deficit and at most2eta conditioned on surplus, by marginal outflow balance and the retention budget. Conditional on J,X and other hidden pair signs, the two laws differ only in that pair, with single-Q KL kappa=(2delta/d)log((1+delta)/(1-delta))<=128eta^2/d. Bounded stopped likelihood increments under finite E N_Q give transcript KL<=kappa E_-N_Q; binary data processing gives kl(4eta||2eta)>=(4log2-2)eta. Averaging the paired hypotheses loses at most a constant; odd d uses the largest even subalphabet. No hard-cap conversion/exponential moment or resampled-original-row premise is used. Together with N_Q>=m and accepted upper algorithms this yields Omega(m+d/eta)<=C*<=O(min{md/eta,m+d/eta^2}); in particular C*(d,1,eta)=Theta(d/eta). Intermediate m remains open.

costs: Supplied old m acquisition/storage and m output labels are charged in an end-to-end application. Hybrid L=ceil(1/eta), N=max(m,ceil((d-1)/eta^2)) chooses new-call mean min{m[1+2d(L-1)],2N-m}. With B=bits(d,m,a,b),eta=a/b,S=B+m ceil(log2 d),H=1+B+ceil(log2(N+2))+ceil(log2(d+2)), source supplies expected local bit work <=C0(S+B^3+NH^3) and memory O(S+N(log(N+2)+log(d+2))); fair-bit integer rejection expected work and parameter construction included. Physical oracle implementation costs remain separately unspecified. ROOT delta is an exact finite rational O(m^2)-term binomial sum with O(m log d+log m)-bit integers; explicit m-list costs are not polylog m.
